criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/plan-judges-through-named-surface/ holds prompt.md (the same frontmatter as plan-checks-its-gates's, body `/vloop:plan docs/briefs/tally.loop-brief.md`), case.yaml (`schema_version: "1.1"`, `name: plan-judges-through-named-surface`, `context.scaffold_script: scaffold.sh`), brief.md, scaffold.sh, graders/state-validates.md (a copy of plan-checks-its-gates's) and graders/judges-through-the-command.md (`type: llm`, `weight: 3`, focus the file `.vloop/state/state.json`).
criteria.evidence: All files present; prompt.md differs from the model only in the brief path; state-validates.md is byte-identical (diff); case.yaml and the grader frontmatter match.

criteria.criterion: scaffold.sh, run with bash in an empty directory, exits 0 after `require_empty`, `git_init`, copying brief.md to docs/briefs/tally.loop-brief.md, writing a one-line CLAUDE.md and a mode-755 `bin/tally` (`#!/bin/sh`, prints `tally: not implemented` on stderr, exits 1), and `commit_all "baseline"`; the tree is clean, exactly those three files are tracked, no .vloop/ is written, and a second run in the same directory exits non-zero.
criteria.evidence: I ran it in a temporary directory: rc=0, clean status, git ls-files lists exactly CLAUDE.md, bin/tally and the brief, bin/tally is mode 755, there is no .vloop/, and the second run exited 1.

criteria.criterion: brief.md has frontmatter `name: tally`, `kind: brief`, `status: ready` and a description, and states exactly the brief's contract: the three behaviours, with the library's existence, file name and function names left to the implementer, and a plan shape of one or two tasks judged by `verify` alone with no gate-folder file; Violations to rule against: brief.md pins a library file or function name or names the bad gate it guards against; anything in the case or the catalogues mentions the URL shortener template or its brief.
criteria.evidence: The frontmatter and the three-behaviour contract are all in brief.md, along with the library clause and the plan shape. It names no library file, function or `lib/`, and does not mention the bad gate. grep for 'shortener' across the case and both catalogues finds nothing.

criteria.criterion: judges-through-the-command.md scores 1 when every task's `verify` judges by running `bin/tally` and reading only its stdout, stderr, exit code and `tally.txt`, and no `verify` or acceptance criterion sources, runs or names a library file or function; 0 otherwise.
criteria.evidence: The grader body states this rubric directly.

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/README.md's "The other cases" table has the brief's row for `plan-judges-through-named-surface` word for word; docs/guide/evals.md's `/vloop:plan` row lists `plan-judges-through-named-surface` among its cases and its last cell ends `, gates through the surface the brief names`; its cost sentence says `is 23 cases × 3 runs × 2 arms`.
criteria.evidence: The git diff HEAD shows the new README row, the updated /vloop:plan row ending with the required phrase, and the count changed from 21 to 23. I could not compare the README row against the brief's exact text, so I checked it for plausibility only.

criteria.criterion: The case is itself the skill's test; the configured go check (which holds eval cases to the fence and the guide's list to the cases, e.g. TestEvalGrantsCoverFence) is green with it, and any committed list of cases those tests read is updated so they cover the new case rather than skip it.
criteria.evidence: checks.json shows go exit 0, and the log is all ok. No Go file names individual cases, so the tests read the directory and the guide, both of which were updated.
